query: data-driven parameter tuning approach for retrieval quality

seed_memories.content: The data-driven parameter tuning approach for retrieval quality replaces hardcoded knobs with feedback-driven optimization: counterfactual replay learns the fusion alpha that would have maximized relevance, per-cluster Kaplan-Meier survival curves replace fixed half-lives, and tier boundaries float on a streaming t-digest of cluster strength.
seed_memories.summary: Data-driven parameter tuning approach for retrieval quality: counterfactual plus survival plus tiering.
